outlets.name: Atlas Obscura
outlets.credible: National curated travel/oddity outlet with editorial standards; publishes a full Erie itinerary and vetted place entries (Schaefer's Auto Art, Lawrence Park Dinor). Already trusted for other cities in this repo.

outlets.name: PA Bucket List
outlets.credible: Established Pennsylvania travel site (Rachel/Chris) with firsthand, county-by-county coverage; recurring on the reuse list. Deep original Erie-County reporting (Schaefer's, Asbury Woods, lighthouses).

outlets.name: VisitPA (Pennsylvania Tourism Office)
outlets.credible: Official statewide destination-marketing organization; vetted listings and editorial (Erie lighthouses guide, Oliver's Rooftop, Bro Man's, Splash Lagoon).

outlets.name: Only In Your State — Pennsylvania
outlets.credible: National travel-discovery outlet that runs best-of-PA features; named Oliver's Rooftop the most romantic restaurant in PA. On the reuse list.

outlets.name: Roadside America
outlets.credible: Long-running national roadside-attraction guide with firsthand field entries; on the reuse list. Documents the Wayne Blockhouse / 'Mad Anthony' burial site.

outlets.name: Lake Erie Living
outlets.credible: Regional lifestyle magazine covering the Lake Erie shore (PA/OH/NY) with a juried annual 'Best of Lake Erie'; named Lawrence Park Dinor best dinor.

outlets.name: Visit Edinboro PA (Edinboro tourism)
outlets.credible: Edinboro's local visitors'/tourism site; vetted dining listings for the Edinboro University college town (John's Wildwood, Flip Cafe).

outlets.name: Erie Yesterday
outlets.credible: Consortium of Erie-area museums and historical sites; authoritative institutional source on local history (Firefighters Historical Museum).

outlets.name: Hagen History Center (Erie County Historical Society)
outlets.credible: The Erie County Historical Society's museum and archive — institutional authority on Erie history (Anthony Wayne death and burial).

outlets.name: Pittsburgh & Western PA Museum Council
outlets.credible: Regional museum-council directory that vets member institutions across western/northwestern PA (Firefighters Historical Museum, Erie).

outlets.name: Pennsylvania Wines (PA Winery Association)
outlets.credible: The state winery association's official directory; licensing-verified winery/meadery listings (Blissful Meads).

outlets.name: Islands.com
outlets.credible: National travel-editorial outlet (Static Media) running vetted destination features; profiled Presque Isle Wine Cellars as PA's oldest operating winery.
